name: AnimatedCrossFade
description: A widget that cross-fades between two children and animates their size over a given duration. Useful for smoothly transitioning between two widgets.
how_to_use:
AnimatedCrossFade(
  firstChild: Container(
    width: 100,
    height: 100,
    color: Colors.blue,
    child: Center(child: Text('First')),
  ),
  secondChild: Container(
    width: 150,
    height: 150,
    color: Colors.red,
    child: Center(child: Text('Second')),
  ),
  crossFadeState: _showFirst ? CrossFadeState.showFirst : CrossFadeState.showSecond,
  duration: const Duration(seconds: 1),
  firstCurve: Curves.easeIn,
  secondCurve: Curves.easeOut,
);

properties.name: firstChild
properties.description: The first widget to display in the cross-fade.

properties.name: secondChild
properties.description: The second widget to display in the cross-fade.

properties.name: duration
properties.description: The length of time over which to animate the cross-fade.

properties.name: reverseDuration
properties.description: The duration of the reverse animation. If null, uses `duration`.

properties.name: sizeCurve
properties.description: The curve to apply to the size animation during the cross-fade.

properties.name: firstCurve
properties.description: The curve to apply to the first child’s opacity animation.

properties.name: secondCurve
properties.description: The curve to apply to the second child’s opacity animation.

properties.name: alignment
properties.description: The alignment of the children within the parent during the cross-fade.
properties.possible_values: Any Alignment, e.g., Alignment.topLeft, Alignment.center, etc.
